The strengthened final canary directly attempts LocalState creation and requires ACCESS_DENIED; all generations passed. Production source was unchanged; the failed suite disposed normally.

limits: Only native Windows 11 client AMD64, OS 10.0 builds 22000..29999, is accepted; no Server, Windows 10, or ARM64 emulation.
Alternate-logon execution/recovery was unavailable; origin session/logon mismatch is refused before mutation. Simulated mismatch is a rejection test, not cross-logon qualification.

A foreign-user-owned job was not constructible without another logon; recovery now checks the actual kernel job owner and rejects a foreign owner. Same-owner collision and retained-job recovery were exercised.
Process termination and injected write/flush/replace failures are measured; arbitrary hardware power-loss durability is not claimed.
Trusted host caller and exclusive FVS lifecycle/setup coordination are required. Hostile concurrent same-user filesystem/ACL tampering is outside the threat model; detected changes fail closed.
Fixed local NTFS canonical paths only; general long-path, reparse, hardlink, network-share, case-sensitive directory support is not claimed.
Ambient OS registry/device access is not an exhaustive zero-access proof. No elevated privileges or global policy changes were used.
Full source-build distribution/public command acceptance is separate from these native primitive tests and must succeed before the support gate is enabled.
